issues.detail: The skill does not cover all possible error scenarios and edge cases, such as handling missing environment variables or Docker Compose failures.
The skill contains verbose explanations that may be considered padded, reducing overall conciseness.

scenarios.name: deploy-production-docker-compose
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric items, while Response B omits key services, environment variables, and required configuration details.

scenarios.name: scale-n8n-queue-redis
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers the required docker‑compose snippet, scaling command, and sidecar service, but omits the explicit note that each worker needs its own task‑runners sidecar; Response A lacks the key EXECUTIONS_MODE, queue host, health check, and sidecar details.

scenarios.name: backup-workflows-credentials-cli
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required docker exec and docker cp commands and almost all rubric items, while Response B omits the docker exec/CP steps and fails to mention the .n8n volume encryption key.
